description: Defines data structures and functions for managing reference records and reflog entries in a reftable system, including ref record types, accessors, and memory management functions.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val1
methods.description: Returns the first hash of the reference record if type is VAL1 or VAL2.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val2
methods.description: Returns the second hash of the reference record if type is VAL2.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if the reference record indicates a deletion.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_release
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a reference record.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_equal
methods.description: Compares two reference records for equality.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if the log record indicates a deletion.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_release
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a log record.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_equal
methods.description: Compares two log records for equality.
